title: Drew's privately funded vacuum chambers
summary: Charles Buer tells of Drew's privately funded vacuum chambers, about present at Drew's house, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He's got one at his house.

plain: A man named Charles Buer says that his colleague Andrew Arjima, known as Drew, has paid for his own vacuum chamber, a sealed tank with the air pumped out that is used for testing equipment, and keeps one at his house. He mentions it on a podcast about claims of new propulsion technology, as a sign of how seriously Drew pursues his experiments on his own.
